# Lots and Parcels Price (For different Communities)

> **Unofficial version, for personal and non-commercial use only.** © Government of Yukon. Not endorsed by or affiliated with the Government of Yukon. Text obtained from the [official source](https://laws.yukon.ca/cms/images/LEGISLATION/SUBORDINATE/1986/1986-0022/1986-0022_1.pdf) via the [A2AJ Canadian Laws dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/a2aj/canadian-laws). Always check the official version before relying on it.

YOIC 1986/22

*Made under the Lands Act*

Pursuant to section 13 of the Lands Act , and sections

22, 37, 50 and 64 of the Lands Regulations, the

Commissioner in Executive Council orders as follows:

1 The lots and parcels as set out on the annexed

Appendix A shall be sold for the sale prices prescribed

thereon.

Dated at Whitehorse, in the Yukon Territory, this 28th

day of January, A.D., 1986.

______________________________

Commissioner of the Yukon
